Journey to Freedom: A mini-fantasy collection
released 11 December 2019
Adult Fiction, Fantasy

A mini fantasy collection. Four stories with common themes of oppression and struggle. The main characters crave freedom, but can they find what they are looking for? Read more »

Available in paperback and various digital formats.

House on the Hill: A Cat and Mouse Adventure
released 9 July 2019
Children’s Fiction (9+), Adventure

Eleven-year-old twins, Cat and Mouse, crave adventure but when the school bully talks them into taking a ride on a dodgy-looking canoe, they know it can only lead to disaster. Proven right, they must learn how to deal with the bully and the man who lives in the sinister house on the hill. Read more »

Available in paperback and various digital formats.

Domino Effect: A Dark Novel
released 7 January 2019
Adult, Dark Fiction

Domino Effect is a dark novel showing a family in despair after a loved one dies by suicide and the effect one person’s decision has on those left behind. The story is fictitious, but the emotions and some scenes are based on real experiences. Read more »

Available in paperback and various digital formats.

The Lion Gods (Land of Miu, #3)
released 1 June 2018
Children’s Fiction (9+), Fantasy

When Princess Alara is informed Manu has been struck by a deadly fever, she is told to find Aker, who can provide an antidote. But is Aker just a myth? Read more »

Available in paperback and various digital formats.

The King’s Riddle (Land of Miu, #2, 2nd ed.)

Children’s Fiction (9+), Fantasy

A Miuan princess and her guard-in-training activate the volcano deep beneath the tunnels in which they live and must solve an ancient riddle to save the people of Miu. Read more »

The Land of Miu (Land of Miu, #1, 3rd ed.)
released 3 May 2015
Children’s Fiction (9+), Fantasy

Anthologies

Hope: An Anthology of Speculative Fiction to Help Raise Suicide Awareness
released 7 October 2011 (Out of print 31 December 2014)
Speculative Fiction Anthology

Thirteen Australian speculative fiction writers take you from the great unknown of our own planet, to the stars, and beyond to mystical fantasy worlds. Includes my story “Boundaries”. Read more »

Published by Kayelle Press.

100 Stories for Queensland
released May 2011
Mixed Genre Anthology

This anthology has something for everyone — slice of life, science fiction, fantasy, romance, paranormal, and literary fiction. Includes my story “Amunet’s Gift”. Read more »

All profits were donated to the Queensland Premier’s Flood Relief Appeal.

Published by eMergent Publishing.

Speculative Realms: Where there’s a will, there’s a way
released July 2008 (Out of print 31 December 2014)
Fantasy, Science Fiction, Horror

A collection of fantasy, science fiction and horror stories exploring determination and desire. Includes my story “Where Strength Lies”. Read more »

Published by Speculative Realms.
